name: tickbell-node
description: TickBell 2.0 self-hosted Node.js / Docker runtime (Hono + SQLite WAL + Proxies + Auto-Backup)

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);" --external:better-sqlite3 --external:@hono/node-server --external:cron --external:undici --outfile=dist/main.mjs
